title: City Council Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Marci Houseman, that the Council formally initiate proceedings, consistent with the recommendation received from the Planning Commission, to review and amend the City's land use regulations in a manner that would limit the number of transitional housing facilities that may be allowed within the City. City staff is hereby requested to study this issue and bring back to the Council a recommendation for appropriate changes to the City's land use code, for consideration and decision by the Council within 180 days
